description: Per-release provenance for auditable, reproducible data (docs D/R) plus the doc-H reproducibility gates: a content schema_hash distinct from the SCHEMA_VERSION string, feature/tensorization stats, and a versioned benchmark-manifest reference.

benchmark_manifest.description: Versioned reference to the benchmark manifest this release was scored against: the benchmark tracks and a manifest URI (doc H Reproducibility gates; evaluation 'Benchmark manifests').

feature_stats.description: Tensorization metadata / feature stats for the release: padded shape caps, per-entity latent widths, compile buckets, and message-passing depth (doc D outputs; doc H Reproducibility gates). 'uri' optionally points at a fuller feature-stats artifact.

schema_hash.description: Content hash of the canonical JSON-Schema contract set (<algo>:<hexdigest>). Distinct from the SCHEMA_VERSION string: it changes whenever any contract *shape* drifts, even within a version.

title: provenance_manifest
